sentences: The lane is **S1[4:0] in wave32** and S1[5:0] in wave64, from an SGPR or a constant, and EXEC is ignored (RDNA 3 ISA guide pseudocode for both opcodes; RDNA 2 has the same encoding and gives no pseudocode).

**Until #488 (SHADER-52) a wave32 shader masked with 63 as well**: a lane select of 32 or more wrote no lane, and a read shuffled from a lane past the end of a 32-wide subgroup, which SPIR-V leaves undefined (NVIDIA wraps it, so reads happened to come out right there).
Found by the FUZZ-7 cross-lane fuzzer: 23 of 100 random wave32 programs, each minimized to `s_mov_b32 s28, K; v_writelane_b32 vD, x, s28` with K ≥ 32.

GPU-checked with `runtime/test/shaders/cs_w32_lane_wrap.asm` (25 16 777 777) on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 (#488) and RTX 4090 (subgroup 32, driver 621.14); `tests/test_translate.py` checks the masks in the SPIR-V, and `tests/semantic/test_wave32_lane_select.py` runs the shader across 32 lanes, where a mask of 63 is an out-of-range shuffle.
